body.en:
Almost every torque figure in circulation is a translation. The joint was designed for a preload — a tension in the bolt that keeps the joint closed — and torque is the workshop-friendly way of trying to produce it. The translation is lossy: most of the torque goes into overcoming friction under the head and in the thread, and only a fraction becomes tension.

That fraction varies with everything the fitter cannot see. The same wrench, the same bolt, the same torque, on a dry thread and on a lubricated thread, produce very different preloads; the same torque on a zinc-flake coated bolt and on a plain one produce different preloads again. This is why a joint that was "tightened to specification" can be loose or over-stretched depending on what happened to the fastener before it was installed.

The consequence for procurement is that the fastener is not a commodity in this application. A bolt bought to a property class has its strength defined; its friction is not defined by the class, and friction is what the torque actually spends itself on. Two suppliers, both compliant, can deliver bolts that need different torque to reach the same preload.

The second consequence is that the useful deliverable from a supplier is not a torque number but a torque-tension relationship: what preload a given torque produces with this bolt, this coating and this lubrication, measured rather than assumed. That is the piece of information a designer can actually use.

Once that is understood, the whole topic organises itself: preload is the requirement, torque is one method of achieving it, friction is the variable that makes the method unreliable, and measurement is how you find out what actually happened.
body.zh:
市面上流传的扭矩数字，几乎都是一个"翻译结果"。接头设计要的是预紧力——螺栓里那股让接头保持闭合的拉力——而扭矩是车间里能操作的那种近似手段。这个翻译是有损的：施加的扭矩大部分消耗在螺栓头和螺纹的摩擦上，只有一小部分变成拉力。

这个小比例，取决于装配工看不见的一堆东西。同一把扳手、同一颗螺栓、同一个扭矩，干螺纹和涂油螺纹得到的预紧力差很远；镀锌片涂层的螺栓和光面螺栓，同一个扭矩得到的预紧力又不一样。所以"按规格拧紧"的接头，既可能偏松，也可能被拉过头，取决于这颗螺栓在装上之前经历了什么。

对采购来说，后果是这类场合的紧固件不算大宗货。按性能等级买的螺栓，强度是被定义好的；摩擦没有被等级定义，而扭矩真正消耗掉的就是摩擦。两家都合规的供应商，交来的螺栓可能要不同的扭矩才能达到同一个预紧力。

第二个后果是：供应商真正有用的交付物不是一个扭矩数字，而是一条扭矩—轴力关系——这颗螺栓、这个涂层、这种润滑条件下，给定扭矩换来多少预紧力，而且是测出来的、不是假设的。这才是设计人员能用的东西。

把这几层想清楚，整件事就顺了：预紧力是需求，扭矩是达成它的一种方法，摩擦是让这个方法不可靠的变量，而测量是弄清"实际到底是多少"的唯一办法。

body.en:
Torque divides into two parts, and the split is decided by friction. The thread friction is the resistance between the mating threads; the head or nut friction is the resistance between the bearing surface and the material it presses on. Together they consume the majority of the applied torque, and the remainder becomes bolt tension.

The friction coefficient itself is not a single number; it is a working range that depends on the finish of the surfaces, the presence and type of lubricant, the coating, and the hardness of the parts in contact. This is why practice works with a range rather than a value, and why a supplier who quotes a single friction coefficient for all its products is simplifying something that is not simple.

The third input is the geometry of the bearing surface. A washer spreads the load and changes the friction couple; a flange head changes it again; a different thread pitch changes the mechanical advantage. Two bolts of the same class with different head forms do not convert the same torque into the same tension.

The fourth input is the elastic behaviour of the joint. A short, stiff joint and a long, compliant one reach different tension from the same torque, because part of the rotation goes into compressing the joint rather than stretching the bolt. This is why the same bolt in two different assemblies needs two different torque values, and why a value copied from another project is meaningless.

The fifth input is the condition of the fastener itself: plating thickness, coating type, thread condition, whether it has been tightened before. A bolt that has been run up once and loosened has a different friction than a new one, which is why re-used fasteners in critical joints are a separate decision rather than a default.
body.zh:
扭矩分成两半，怎么分由摩擦决定。螺纹摩擦是内外螺纹之间的阻力；头部或螺母摩擦是支承面与被压表面之间的阻力。这两块吃掉施加扭矩的大部分，剩下的才变成螺栓拉力。

摩擦系数本身不是一个数，而是一个工作区间，取决于表面粗糙度、有没有润滑剂以及润滑剂种类、涂层、接触件的硬度。所以实务上用区间而不是用单值，也所以一个对所有产品都报同一个摩擦系数的供应商，是把不简单的事情简化掉了。

第三个变量是支承面几何。加了垫圈，载荷摊开、摩擦副变了；法兰面头部又变一次；螺距不同，机械增益也不同。同一个等级、不同头型的螺栓，不会把同一个扭矩换成同一个拉力。

第四个变量是接头的弹性行为。短而刚的接头和长而柔的接头，同一个扭矩得到的拉力不同，因为有一部分转角被用来压缩接头，而不是拉伸螺栓。这就是同一颗螺栓装在两种组件上要两个扭矩值的原因，也是从别的项目抄来的数字没有意义的原因。

第五个变量是紧固件自身的状态：镀层厚度、涂层类型、螺纹状态、是否已经被拧过。拧过一次又松开的螺栓，摩擦和新件不一样——所以关键接头里的重复使用是一个要留记录的决定，而不是默认做法。

Para aplicações em mercados específicos, podem se aplicar normas regionais adicionais. Para projetos de infraestrutura africana, consulte requisitos de importação SABS da África do Sul. Para compras focadas no Zimbábue, consulte especificações de fixadores para construção do Zimbábue.

Para informações detalhadas sobre produtos relacionados, consulte parafusos de alta resistência premium e guia de grau de parafusos de alta resistência.

A aquisição baseada em normas requer aprendizado contínuo, pois as normas ISO, ASTM, DIN e GB são revisadas a cada 3-5 anos. Assine notificações de atualização de normas e revise as especificações anualmente. As normas mais comumente usadas no comércio internacional de fixadores são ISO 898-1 (propriedades mecânicas), ISO 3506-1 (aço inoxidável), ISO 3269 (inspeção de aceitação), ISO 4042 (revestimentos) e ISO 1502 (calibradores de rosca).

Para compradores B2B, construir uma biblioteca de referência de normas com pelo menos as 20 principais normas relevantes para sua mix de produtos é essencial para garantir conformidade regulatória e qualidade consistente. A atualização regular da biblioteca de normas é crucial porque novas versões frequentemente introduzem requisitos mais rigorosos que refletem avanços em tecnologia de fabricação, понимание de mecanismos de falha e melhores práticas da indústria que evoluíram desde a publicação das versões anteriores das normas.

body.en:
A torque table is the most common document in this field and the least useful, because it presents a single number as if it were a property of the bolt. In practice that number is a property of a system: this bolt, this coating, this lubricant, this joint, this tightening method. Change one and the table is wrong, and the table does not say which one it assumed.

The failure modes of a table-driven approach are predictable. If friction is higher than the table assumed, the specified torque produces less preload than the design needs, and the joint loosens under vibration. If friction is lower, the same torque over-stretches the bolt, and the failure is a bolt that breaks during tightening or shortly after.

The second problem is that tables travel. A table written for one project is copied into another, with different bolt lengths, different washers and a different tightening tool, and nobody records that the assumptions changed. The number survives; the reasoning behind it does not.

What a designer actually needs is a specification of the joint: the preload required, the tolerance on that preload, the friction range assumed, the tightening method, and the verification method. From those, a torque value can be derived for a specific combination, and it can be re-derived when the combination changes.

A supplier's useful contribution is the friction data and the torque-tension test behind it, not a table of numbers. A buyer asking for the table is asking for the output without the assumptions; a buyer asking for the test data is asking for something that can be checked.
body.zh:
扭矩表是这一行最常见的文件，也是最没用的，因为它把一个单值当成螺栓的固有属性来呈现。实际上那个数是系统的属性：这颗螺栓、这个涂层、这种润滑剂、这个接头、这种拧紧方法。换掉任何一项，表就错了，而表不会告诉你它假设了哪一项。

靠表办事的失效方式是可预测的。如果实际摩擦比表假设的高，给定扭矩产生的预紧力就低于设计需要，接头在振动下松掉；如果实际摩擦更低，同一个扭矩就把螺栓拉过头，失效形式是拧紧过程中或拧完不久螺栓断掉。

第二个问题是表会自己走路。为一个项目写的表被抄到另一个项目，螺栓长度不同、垫圈不同、工具也不同，而没人记录"假设变了"。数字活下来了，背后的推理没有。

设计人员真正需要的是一份接头规格：需要多少预紧力、预紧力的公差、假设的摩擦区间、拧紧方法、验证方法。有了这几项，才能针对某个具体组合推出扭矩值；组合一变，可以重新推一遍。

供应商有价值的贡献是摩擦数据和它背后的扭矩—轴力试验，而不是一张数字表。要表的买方是在要结论、不要假设；要试验数据的买方是在要一样可以被核对的东西。

body.en:
Where the consequence of a loose or over-stretched joint is serious, the industry stops translating and measures preload directly. The methods differ in accuracy, in cost, and in what they require of the operator.

Torque control is the cheapest and the least accurate: it assumes the friction, and its accuracy is the accuracy of that assumption. It is adequate for joints with generous tolerance and non-critical consequences, and it is not adequate where the preload range is narrow.

Torque and angle control improves on it by going past the elastic region: the fastener is run to a seating torque and then rotated through a specified angle, so the final tension is set by thread geometry rather than by friction. It is more accurate and it requires a tool that can count rotation, plus a joint where the geometry is known.

Direct tension measurement is the accurate end: measuring bolt stretch (by ultrasonic or by a mechanical gauge on a calibrated bolt), or using a hydraulic tensioner that applies load without torsion. These methods are slower and more expensive per joint, and they are the right choice where the joint's integrity is the point of the design.

The choice is therefore a design decision, not a purchasing one: the tightening method belongs with the joint design, and the fastener requirement follows from it. A buyer who is asked to supply "bolts for a torque-controlled joint" is supplying a friction-sensitive part, and should say so.
body.zh:
当接头偏松或被拉过头的后果很严重时，行业就不再做翻译，改成直接量预紧力。几种方法在精度、成本、对操作者的要求上各不相同。

扭矩控制最便宜、精度最低：它假设了摩擦，精度就是这个假设的精度。预紧力公差宽、后果不严重的接头够用；预紧力区间窄的接头不够用。

扭矩加转角控制往前走了一步，越过弹性区：先拧到贴合扭矩，再转过规定角度，最终拉力由螺纹几何决定，而不是由摩擦决定。精度更高，需要能计转角的工具，也需要几何已知的接头。

直接测拉力是精度那一端：测螺栓伸长（超声法，或者在标定过的螺栓上用机械量具），或者用液压拉伸器在不施加扭转的情况下加载。这些方法慢、单点成本高，而当"接头完整性"就是设计目的时，它们才是对的选择。

所以这道选择属于设计决定，不属于采购决定：拧紧方法归接头设计，紧固件的要求由它推出来。被要求"供一批用于扭矩控制接头的螺栓"的买方，其实是在供一个对摩擦敏感的东西，应该把这句话讲明白。

Certificado de teste de usina (MTC): Documento original da usina siderúrgica mostrando número de lote de aço, composição química verificada por análise espectrométrica, e propriedades mecânicas obtidas através de testes de tração e dureza padronizados que confirmam a conformidade com os graus especificados.
  2. Certificado ISO 9001: Certificado atual de órgão de certificação credenciado (exemplos reconhecidos: TUV, Bureau Veritas, SGS) que demonstra que o sistema de gestão da qualidade do fornecedor foi auditado e aprovado por uma terceira parte independente e competente.
  3. Verificação de marcação de grau: Inspeção visual minuciosa da marcação na cabeça que deve corresponder exatamente à especificação do pedido de compra (8.8, 10.9, 12.9, A2-70, etc.) com símbolos corretos e legíveis conforme as normas aplicables.
  4. Verificação dimensional: Verificação com calibrador de passo de rosca, paquímetro e micrômetro em 5-10 amostras por lote para confirmar que todas as dimensões críticas estão dentro das tolerâncias especificadas pelas normas aplicáveis.
  5. Teste de dureza: Testador de dureza portátil em amostras representativas do lote (escala HRC para grau 8.8+, escala HRB para graus inferiores) com verificação de que os valores medidos estão dentro das faixas especificadas para cada grau de resistência.
  6. Espessura do revestimento: Análise por fluorescência de raios X (XRF) ou medidor magnético para revestimentos de zinco, galvanização por imersão a quente (HDG), ou outros revestimentos de proteção contra corrosão aplicados ao fixador.
  7. Inspeção visual: Verificação detalhada de ausência de trincas, rebarbas, ou defeitos superficiais nas roscas e na cabeça do fixador que poderiam comprometer a integridade estrutural ou causar dificuldades durante a instalação.
  8. Calibrador de rosca: Verificação com calibrador Go/No-Go conforme ISO 1502 ou ASME B1.16M para garantir que as roscas estão fabricadas dentro das tolerâncias dimensionais especificadas e são completamente funcionais para a aplicação pretendida.
  9. Embalagem: Verificação de que os rótulos originais do fabricante estão presentes com números de lote, descrições claras do produto e informações de identificação necessárias, além de verificação da adequação da embalagem para proteção durante o transporte internacional.
  10. Verificação de quantidade: Contagem de peças 100% completa com verificação de peso (kg por 1000 peças) para confirmar que a quantidade solicitada foi efetivamente embalada e está pronta para expedição conforme o pedido de compra.

Para pedidos de alto valor, contrate uma agência de inspeção terceirizada (SGS, Bureau Veritas, Intertek, TUV) para executar a lista de verificação em seu nome. Custo típico: 0,5-1,5% do valor do pedido, o que representa economia significativa quando comparado ao custo de recuperação de falhas que pode ser 10 a 100 vezes superior ao custo da inspeção preventiva.

A lista de verificação de verificação aplica-se tanto à qualificação inicial de fornecedores quanto à inspeção contínua de lotes. Para aplicações de alto risco (estruturas de suporte de carga, vasos de pressão, mineração, ambiente marinho), adicione testes de fadiga, testes de névoa salina (ASTM B117), testes de torque-tensão em equipamentos especializados, e inspeção pós-instalação por técnicos qualificados para garantir o desempenho adequado durante toda a vida útil da aplicação.

body.en:
Before anything is tightened, three things should be verifiable, and all three are documents rather than opinions. The first is the tool: a torque wrench or torque-controlled tool with a calibration record inside its valid period, and a calibration that covers the range being used rather than only the top of the scale.

The second is the fastener batch: property class marking, coating class, and the friction condition the torque value was derived for. If the bolts arrive with a different coating from the one the calculation assumed, the torque value is no longer the one that was calculated, and this is a change that happens silently when a supplier substitutes a coating mid-order.

The third is the joint itself: the washers, the surface condition, the lubrication, and whether the assembly matches the one the value was derived for. A change of washer is a change of friction; a painted surface under the head is a change of friction; a dry joint substituted for a lubricated one is a large change of friction.

The verification that ties these together is a torque-tension check on a sample: tighten a few assemblies with the production tool, measure the resulting tension, and compare with the design range. It is a short test, it can be done with a load cell in a workshop, and it converts three documents into one measurement.

The record matters as much as the test. If the torque value, the tool calibration, the batch coating and the sample result are written down together, a joint that fails later can be investigated; if they are scattered, the investigation starts from nothing.
body.zh:
在拧下第一下之前，有三样东西应当是可核实的，而且三样都是文件，不是意见。第一是工具：扭矩扳手或扭矩控制工具，校准记录在有效期内，而且校准覆盖的区间要包含实际使用的区间，不只是量程顶端。

第二是螺栓批次：性能等级标记、镀层等级、以及推出那个扭矩值时所假设的摩擦状态。如果到货的螺栓涂层和计算假设的不一样，那个扭矩值就不再是当初算出来的值——这种变更在供应商订单中途换涂层时会悄悄发生。

第三是接头本身：垫圈、表面状态、润滑、以及装配是否和推出数值时的那个组件一致。换垫圈就是换摩擦；头部下面是漆面就是换摩擦；把涂油的接头换成干接头，是很大的一次摩擦变化。

把这三样串起来的验证是抽样做一次扭矩—轴力检查：用生产工具拧几组，测出实际拉力，与设计区间比对。这是一个短测试，车间里用测力计就能做，它把三份文件变成了一次测量。

记录和测试本身一样重要。扭矩值、工具校准、批次涂层、抽样结果写在一起，日后接头出问题还能查；散在四处，调查就从零开始。

Sinais de alerta a evitar: 1) Recusa em compartilhar certificados de teste de usina que são documentos essenciais de verificação de qualidade; 2) Não aceitação de inspeção por terceiros independentes que é prática padrão da indústria; 3) Preços 30%+ abaixo da média do mercado que frequentemente indicam qualidade inferior ou práticas comerciais questionáveis; 4) Endereço de fábrica não verificável ou ausência de fotos de produção que permitam confirmar a existência e capacidade real da instalação; 5) Pressão para pagar o valor total antes do início da produção que representa risco financeiro significativo para o comprador.

Etapas de verificação antes do primeiro pedido: 1) Solicitar amostras pré-embarque para testes em laboratório independente que confirmem a conformidade com especificações técnicas; 2) Realizar auditoria de fábrica (presencial ou através de terceiros credenciados) para verificar capacidades reais e sistemas de gestão implementados; 3) Verificar licença comercial e licença de exportação junto às autoridades competentes do país de origem; 4) Verificar referências de clientes existentes que possam confirmar a experiência de trabalho com o fornecedor; 5) Iniciar com um pedido de teste pequeno (10-20% do volume anual projetado) para validar a qualidade e confiabilidade antes de compromissos maiores.

Para compradores B2B africanos, considere fornecedores com experiência estabelecida de exportação para seu mercado específico, armazenamento regional que pode reduzir prazos de entrega, e suporte de documentação para padrões locais obrigatórios (SABS para África do Sul, KEBS para Quênia, ZIMRA para Zimbábue, TBS para Tanzânia, SON para Nigéria) que são frequentemente necessários para importação e uso em projetos de infraestrutura pública.

A avaliação de fornecedores deve ser um processo contínuo e não um exercício único de qualificação. body.en:
Designers and fitters ask a few recurring questions, and the answers are usually about assumptions rather than about numbers.

The most common is what torque to use for a given bolt. The honest answer is that torque comes from the joint and the friction condition, not from the bolt alone, so the question has to become: what preload does this joint need, and what friction range will the parts actually have.

The second is whether a value from another project can be reused. It can be re-derived, not copied, because the joint stiffness, the washer and the tool are usually different even when the bolt is the same. The third is whether re-used bolts can be tightened to the same value; they can be tightened, and their friction is different, which is why critical joints treat re-use as a decision with a record rather than a habit.

The fourth is whether tightening can be checked after the fact. It can, by marking and by sampling with a torque check, and the check itself disturbs the joint, so the sampling plan has to decide how many joints are sacrificed for verification. The fifth is what to do when a bolt breaks during tightening; the answer is usually that the friction was lower than assumed, so the fix is in the friction assumption and the tool setting rather than in a stronger bolt.

See frequently asked questions below.

Related resources: high-tensile bolts anchor bolts stainless steel fasteners hex bolts

设计人员和装配工问来问去就几个问题，答案多半不在数字上，而在假设上。

最常见的是"这颗螺栓该用多少扭矩"。诚实的回答是：扭矩来自接头和摩擦条件，不是来自螺栓本身；所以问题要改成——这个接头需要多少预紧力，这些零件实际的摩擦区间是多少。

第二个是别的项目的数值能不能直接用。可以重新推，不能照抄，因为即使螺栓一样，接头刚度、垫圈和工具通常都不一样。第三个是重复使用的螺栓能不能用同一个值——能拧，但摩擦不同，所以关键接头把重复使用当成一个要留记录的决定，而不是习惯。

第四个是拧紧之后还能不能查。能，靠做标记，加抽样复紧检查；而检查本身会扰动接头，所以抽样方案要决定牺牲多少个接头去验证。第五个是拧紧时螺栓断了怎么办——通常说明摩擦比假设的低，所以要改的是摩擦假设和工具设定，不是换一根更强的螺栓。

a.en: MOQ varies by supplier: small-scale Chinese factories may accept orders from 1-5 tons, mid-size suppliers typically require 5-20 tons, and large mills have MOQs of 20+ tons. For first-time orders, expect higher per-unit pricing below 10 tons due to setup costs. For African B2B buyers, consolidated container loads (FCL 20ft = ~18-20 tons) typically offer the best unit economics; LCL shipments of 1-5 tons are available but at 30-50% higher per-kg cost. For critical bolted joints, the RFQ should state the property class, coating class, lubrication condition, and washer or flange form, because friction changes the torque needed to reach the same preload.
